items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: But with Cab Calloway, we had to change every show. ... He bought all the clothes. He had to pay for all the uniforms.

ctx.x: -- brought it back here and released it. I see.

Because Coleman say -- I understand somebody said to me that -- I got a letter from Coleman Hawkins. Coleman say, 'You guys say everybody say (inaudible) he's going back. But he's going to send you a little message to let you know that he's not going back,' you know. They figured Coleman had been in Europe and he had lost, you know, (inaudible) -- not where they get that idea. playing good, (inaudible). So they released 'Body and Soul' over here. That's when Chuck Berry was on his high horse. He was like, oh man,…
